content:
Looking at the folded packet: the top edge is the second-fold crease and the left edge is the first-fold crease.

- The **top notch** (triangle pointing down, base on the horizontal crease): unfolding the second fold mirrors it across the horizontal center line, creating **tall diamonds** (vertical diagonal longer) centered on that line. Unfolding the first fold duplicates them to the left and right positions. So the left and right holes are **vertically oriented diamonds**.
- The **left notch** (triangle pointing right, base on the vertical crease): unfolding the first fold mirrors it across the vertical center line, creating **wide diamonds** (horizontal diagonal longer) centered on that line. Unfolding the second fold duplicates them to top and bottom positions. So the top and bottom holes are **horizontally oriented diamonds**.

The unfolded paper therefore shows four diamonds: wide (horizontal) ones at top and bottom, and tall (vertical) ones at left and right — exactly diagram C.

\boxed{C}
